_doc: Fourteen places that fill a zone in. These are put on the map's existing landmark and pass nodes plus new slots at road junctions and river fords, and each is something you DO, not scenery. `solve` means it has a state a player can change; `uses` says which job frames can bind to it. Original names and ideas only.

landmarks.name: Wayshrine
landmarks.blurb: A lit stone and a shallow bowl, kept by nobody in particular.
landmarks.does: Rest here without making camp. Once a day it will bring a fallen companion back.

landmarks.name: Standing Stones
landmarks.blurb: Five stones in a ring and a sixth on its side in the grass.
landmarks.does: Put the fallen stone back up. It takes a while and something watches you do it.

landmarks.name: Watchtower
landmarks.blurb: Twelve metres of dry stone with a ladder still in it.
landmarks.does: Climb it and the whole zone goes on your map. A patrol beds down here at night.

landmarks.name: Gibbet
landmarks.blurb: A cage on a post, and what is left of somebody's last argument.
landmarks.does: Read the plate. Whoever put them there is still out there, and now you know its name.

landmarks.name: Burnt Farm
landmarks.blurb: Four walls, no roof, and a cellar door nobody opened.
landmarks.does: The cellar is still full. So is the well, and that is a different matter.

landmarks.name: Collapsed Mine
landmarks.blurb: A mouth full of rubble and a rail line that stops at it.
landmarks.does: Three days' digging, a day at a time. Then it is a dungeon.

landmarks.name: Ferry Landing
landmarks.blurb: A flat boat, a rope, and somebody who would rather you paid.
landmarks.does: Cross without swimming. Free if the Cut like you.

landmarks.name: Toll Bridge
landmarks.blurb: A good bridge, a chain across it, and a chair.
landmarks.does: Pay, fight, or ford it somewhere with a worse bottom.

landmarks.name: Hunting Blind
landmarks.blurb: A platform in a tree and a hook for the bait.
landmarks.does: Hang something on the hook and wait. Whatever comes is bigger than usual.

landmarks.name: Field of Cairns
landmarks.blurb: Thirty piles of stone, laid out in rows by somebody careful.
landmarks.does: Dig one. There is something in it, and there is a reason it was under stone.

landmarks.name: Beacon
landmarks.blurb: A cage of dry wood on the highest thing for a mile, unlit.
landmarks.does: Light it and every friendly patrol in the zone comes. Once, and loudly.

landmarks.name: Sunken Wreck
landmarks.blurb: A hull on its side in four metres of water, still mostly closed.
landmarks.does: Dive it. The Salt say it is theirs and they are not entirely wrong.

landmarks.name: Forge Fire
landmarks.blurb: An anvil under a lean-to and a fire that somehow never goes out.
landmarks.does: A crafting bench, outside a town, which is the whole point of it.

landmarks.name: Broken Road
landmarks.blurb: Forty metres of road that is now forty metres of gully.
landmarks.does: Two days' work with stone from the bank. Then travel through here is faster for good.
